context: Two teens plan a summer festival outing
purpose: Teach: フライト/プロモーション/アナウンス/まつり/街道/庭園/ポーズ/ディレクター

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏まつり、街道沿いの庭園でやるんだって。
lines.en: The summer festival's happening at that garden along the highway.
lines.style: Quick, upbeat opening. Eager to share news. Light, forward momentum—no pause to dwell. Speaking at the pace of something just remembered and already spilling out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね、ライブのアナウンスも入ってる?
lines.en: Oh nice. Do they have live performances too?
lines.style: Interested without overplaying it. Short, genuine. Lean into 「いいね」 lightly—the acknowledgment of something good. Steady, engaged tone. Not performing coolness, just being present.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん。プロモーションムービー作るって、ディレクターさん募集してた。
lines.en: Yeah. They're actually recruiting a director to shoot a promotional video.
lines.style: Pick up energy. Emphasis on the interesting detail—that they're casting. Speaking faster here, like the recruit part is the hook. Slight lift at the end, inviting reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 飛行機にも乗せちゃう企画?
lines.en: A flight plan thing too? Like, actually flying somewhere?
lines.style: Playful skepticism with a real question underneath. Tilt toward teasing but genuinely curious. Slight uptick on 「飛行機にも」 as if testing whether she really means that.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 違うよ、フライトはミニドローンの方。記念のポーズで写真撮りたい。
lines.en: No, the flight part is just mini-drones. I want to get a souvenir photo—everyone doing a pose together.
lines.style: Friendly correction with bright energy. Clarify without making him feel dumb. Build into the real appeal—the shared moment. Warm, inclusive tone. End on the photo idea with genuine enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Soft, genuine close. Quiet warmth. No irony, no distance. Like he's letting her see he actually means it. Slow enough to land—not rushing past the moment.
